entries.title: test
entries.description: just testing backlog feature

entries.title: Teleporting back to the manor should deposit me at the new sign location beside the farm and road
Improve work animations
entries.description: Further heroine action/work animation improvements deferred from measured build 01, separate from already shipped fixes. Polish natural movement, tool contact and transitions when Jenny schedules this work.

entries.title: Improve tool carry holds
entries.description: Further tool-carry polish deferred from measured build 01, separate from the shipped grip/contact fixes. Refine idle and moving holds so grips look natural and tools do not clip through her hands or body.

entries.title: Path to the Mine from the Manor
entries.description: There should be a dedicated path through the woods to the mine from the manor, just as there is to the lake through the trees

entries.title: Build an asset for the Mine - a large stone building I can enter, with a trapdoor in the floor that leads into the Mine
entries.description: Even if the trapdoor is just a placeholder for now, the building for the mine should exist in the world. I should be able to go inside the main room of the first floor, see rocks piled in a corner, a desk, an oil lamp on the desk that let's say burns infinitely but can't be picked up, and a trapdoor in the floor that will later on lead down into the mine.

entries.title: I should be able to Disassemble, Replace Fence around the Farm
entries.description: I should be able to craft new wooden fence parts (sections of fence and gates) in the Build menu and place them around the farm, and I should be able to disassemble the broken down fence that currently exists around the farm first so I can replace it

entries.title: I should be able to go down into the mine and mine for rock, ore and gems
entries.description: The trapdoor in the Mine building asset should be usable, and I should be able to desend into dark tunnels, where I need to use my oil lamp for light, and my pickaxe to mine for ores, stone, and gems, as laid out in our plans. I should be able to sell these items in town and use them in crafting ingredients. Most important is the stone building recipes for rebuilding the manor to its former glory.

entries.title: [Balance] Halve crop growth days
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/balance.md §9 (2026-10-04). Crops take too many in-game days for cozy pacing; halve growth days so a planting pays off within a short play session.

entries.title: [Balance] Cap fishing at 5 fish per water type per day
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/balance.md §9 (2026-10-04). Fishing earns about 200 coins per real minute (~40 per attempt), outpacing crops. Cap catches at 5 per water type per in-game day.

entries.title: [Balance] Snack values: bread 20, cheese 28
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/balance.md §9 (2026-10-04). Set bread to restore 20 energy and cheese 28.

entries.title: [Balance UI] HUD almanac plate
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent UI audit, docs/design/cohesion.md §5 (2026-10-04). Size M. Replace the flat clock, energy and coin rectangles with one framed plate: pocket-watch medallion for the clock, purse tag for coins.

entries.title: [Balance UI] Energy capsule
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent UI audit, docs/design/cohesion.md §5 (2026-10-04). Size S. Energy bar with ticks at 25 and 10, sage fill and a palette icon instead of the plain green bar.

entries.title: [Balance] Fishing: one catch message
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent review of 9 PM fishing (2026-10-04). Catching shows two toasts ("Caught 1 Lake carp." and "+1 Lake carp"). Keep one: "Caught a lake carp." with the species in lower case mid-sentence.

entries.title: [Balance] Fishing: move the cue panel off the heroine
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent review of 9 PM fishing (2026-10-04). The catch cue panel covers her hips and the bank; nudge it down or right of centre.

entries.title: [Balance] Fishing: bigger fish icons
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent review of 9 PM fishing (2026-10-04). Fish icons fill only about 40% of their hotbar cell; scale them up toward the pole icon size.

entries.title: Shrink the map by about half; smaller estate; town closer
entries.description:
The map is too big and it takes too long to get anywhere (Coral Island's size makes sense now). Scale the map down by roughly half, make the estate itself a tad smaller, and bring town closer so walking there doesn't take so long.

Stage 1 shipped 2026-10-04 7:28 PM: the village is now ~300 m / 63 s sprint from the manor, road trimmed to 852 m. Remaining: stage 2, the full half-scale shrink (terrain, water, scatter rebake; large, 3-5 days), per openspec/changes/shrink-estate-map.

entries.title: [Balance] Trees grow back in stages
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/balance.md changelog (9 PM trees, 2026-10-04). A felled forest tree shows a stump, then a sapling on day 1, then a full tree on day 3.

entries.title: [Balance] Landmark trees stay standing
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/balance.md changelog (9 PM trees, 2026-10-04). Trees lining roads and the town square can't be chopped down.

entries.title: [Balance UI] Shopkeeper prop and whiskers
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/cohesion.md §1 (2026-10-04). Give Mr. Trethewey one character prop (a pencil or spectacles) and greyer whiskers.

entries.title: [Balance UI] Call it "the village", not "town", in player copy
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/cohesion.md §2 "Settlement" (2026-10-04). With town now ~200 m from the manor it reads as a village; change "town" to "village" in player-facing copy beyond map labels and the store greeting (fast-travel names, toasts, field book).

entries.title: Add a compost bin
entries.description: Add a compost bin so I can turn unwanted foliage like weeds, bramble canes, etc into a fertilizer that I can use on my crops to yield faster growth and better quality crops (game balancer, help me out here)

entries.title: [Balance UI] Roasted roots steam: two wisps, not three
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/cohesion.md §5 #6 glyph family (2026-10-04). Trim the roasted roots glyph from three steam wisps to two so it matches the other hot dishes.

entries.title: Fishing pole glyph shows a reel
entries.description: Source: Orchestrator, spotted in the meal-glyph comparison preview (2026-10-04). The pole icon has a reel, but Jenny earlier asked for a traditional tip-line pole without a reel. Check the 3D pole too.

entries.title: [Balance UI] Selected-cell icon contrast
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/cohesion.md §3 Selection (2026-10-04). Dark glyphs (hatchet, lamp) lose contrast on the rust selected fill; add a cream halo or lighter ink in the selected cell.

entries.title: [Balance UI] Craft detail subtitle contrast
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/cohesion.md §3 Selection (2026-10-04). The "Makes 1 X · +N Energy" line is dark ink on the rust selected header and nearly unreadable; use cream text there.

entries.title: [Balance] Clerk apron ties hang straight
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/cohesion.md §4 (2026-10-04). Mr. Trethewey's apron tie ends flare out at the hips; make them hang straight.

entries.title: [Balance] Store counter props
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/cohesion.md §4 (2026-10-04). The plain blue cylinder and blank box on the counter read as greybox; swap for period pieces (brass scale, tea canister, twine spool).

entries.title: [Balance] Clerk whiskers and hair sheen
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/cohesion.md §1 (2026-10-04). Strand grooms glittered white/gold under the shop light, so the clerk shipped clean-shaven. Bring back grey mutton-chop side whiskers (no chin beard) as hair cards or a baked texture, and fix the hairline sheen; without them he reads a little soft.

entries.title: Seed split of 1+1 re-merges on load
entries.description: Source: Opus code review of Gameplay 1a31a1b7 (2026-10-04). Splitting a 2-seed stack into 1+1 of the same crop is indistinguishable from legacy single packets and gets folded back into one stack on reload. Fix: gate the legacy fold on save provenance (a flag written by new saves) instead of quantity.

entries.title: Tree focus shows no reason when you can't chop
entries.description: Source: Opus code review of tree felling (2026-10-04). Protected or too-tired trees just stop being targetable with no message; show "[E] Chop" with the refusal reason instead (e.g. too tired, landmark tree).

entries.title: [Balance] Readable regrowth saplings
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/cohesion.md §4 (2026-10-04). A felled oak regrows as a tiny dark fir tuft lost in the grass; use a matching broadleaf sapling at knee-to-waist height, scaling with growth stage.

entries.title: Normal height store clerk
entries.description: There's a pretty big size disparity between the heroine and the general store clerk. Please make him either larger than me or the same size

entries.title: Extend the walkable shore at the Cove
entries.description: I should be able to walk along the beach for several dozens of meters around the staircase / path down to the Cove. Ideally there'd even be a cave in the mountain by the shore.

entries.title: Replace the teleporting signs to the town and to the manor with wooden directional signs pointing the way like we have for the Cove; remove the ability to teleport from them
There should be a walking path from the town down to the river
Low quality wild crops
entries.description: Wild roots / seeds / berries should yield lower quality crops and meals cooked from them should restore less energy and fetch lower prices, thereby incentivizing real crops and purchased seeds

entries.title: Remove derelict farm artifacts when I till the soil
entries.description: The rows in the ground and the tall, leaning sticks in the derelict farm do not clear out of the way nicely when I hoe that area, so they make it hard to farm there. I can barely see where I've tilled, and the tall stick things are just in the way. Please remove them when I hoe in that area to till the soil (but otherwise leave them there until then).

entries.title: Add Quests
entries.description:
We need to give the user a campaign to play through; goals and milestones to aim for and achieve. These should be listed in a new tab in the Book called "Quests" to the right of the Map. These are presented as a checklist of items with a name and a description beneath it in italics, and each one gets its box checked off, its text crossed out, and is moved to the bottom of the list as it gets completed, most recently completed quests listed first so oldest completed are at the bottom. Not every quest should be available when the game starts; some should be unlocked through play, so it's not such an overwhelming list at first. When a new quest is added to the user's book, a toast should appear saying "Quest Unlocked: <Title>". 

I think some of the first ones should be: Clear the Estate (of debris and weeds); Grow Crops (purchase seeds, grow them to completion); Go Fish (acquire a fishing pole and catch your first fish); Iron Tools (acquire first iron tool); Farmer Level 1 (Grow and sell 25 completed crops); Fisher Level 1 (catch 25 fish); Home-Cooked Meals (cook and eat 25 meals); Explorer (visit every marked landmark on the map at least once)

entries.title: Realistic cookfire lifecycle
entries.description: The cookfire in the manor should have its own lifecycle: it goes out after a set number of hours, depending on how much firewood I've given it. It takes kindling to start the fire, let's say a few pieces, maybe 3 or 5. Then it takes firewood to stock the fire to keep it burning for light, and each recipe I want to cook on it takes a piece of firewood. I should only be able to get kindling by gathering it off the ground from fallen branches, so these will need to spawn occasionally in the woods and grounds so I can always gather enough kindling to cook with even after I've cleared the derelict estate of branches the first time.

entries.title: Too many meadow herbs
entries.description: There are about twice as many meadow herb plants as I think I need. Please cut their spawn rate in about half. Also make them saleable at the General Store.

entries.title: Realistic night lighting
entries.description: Right now when the sun sets, it's like a second sun rises in the East, and it really does look like a sun at first, shining very yellow, before it eventually pales out. Please cut the moonrise out entirely and just have the night be dark, but not quite as dark as it gets when the sun first sets - instead, use one of those low levels of persistent moonlight as the lighting for the entire night until the sun rises again. I think this will make nights feel more realistic and incentivize sleep.

entries.title: Add a window to the house
entries.description: Please add a window in the standing room of the manor, so that it lets in natural light and clearly indicates day/night while inside. Right now the lighting swings are crazy when you walk in / out of the room, as the lighting level rebalances, and also after you sleep until morning, it isn't clear that it's morning because it's so dark in the room still. I think if you add an East-facing window it will let in a lot of natural light which should help balance out the swings, and it should clearly indicate in the morning that the sun has risen. Put it beside the bed on that East-facing wall, so that even when the manor is fully restored, it will make sense to have a window on that wall.

entries.title: Tilled soil, left bare, returns to untilled soil
entries.description: Tilled soil, after a day left bare (nothing planted), has a random chance every day thereafter to return to normal, untilled ground.

entries.title: Chopping down a tree yields resources at the end of the animation, not the beginning
Ability to plant trees
entries.description: I should be able to receive tree seeds of a few varieties when I chop down trees, which I can then plant to grow that same type of tree again, allowing me to setup a timber farm on part of the property, replant a forest, or infinitely mine firewood by regrowing my trees.

entries.title: The grass grows in squares
entries.description: The grass grows, or doesn't grow, in obvious squares. Please try to make the grass behave more uniformly and naturally, without random polygons appearing in nature.

entries.title: [Balance] Playtest income after hard fishing
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/balance.md §8 (2026-10-09). After hard fishing ships, playtest fishing income (~45 coins/min); revisit the §8 daily cap or fish prices only if it still trivialises crops.

entries.title: [Balance UI] Cornish hedge in the village
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/cohesion.md §4 (2026-10-09). Replace the village ToyonHedge (a Californian shrub) with a Cornish hedge bank or hawthorn mesh.

entries.title: [Balance] Currants easier to spot
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent review of Upkeep (2026-10-09, upkeep-1/01-thicket-hint.png). Currant strings are hard to see past ~10 m: add a few more trusses or brighten the red.

entries.title: [Balance UI] Dim price on Owned clothing rows
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent pre-ready review of Wardrobe (2026-10-09). On Owned clothing rows in the General Store, dim the price to muted ink so they read as unavailable.

entries.title: [Balance] Stage 2: gentler village street grade
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/balance.md §9 travel (2026-10-09). During map-shrink stage 2, move the village street junction ~232 m up the road so the street grade is at most 12% (currently 21.3% at the kink).

entries.title: [Balance UI] Cobbles, flower strips and cottage beds in the square
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/cohesion.md §4 (2026-10-09). Make the square's cobble apron continuous, add flower strips along the house fronts, and lay cottage beds along walls and fences rather than in a grid.

entries.title: [Balance UI] Call the town "the village" in toasts and labels
entries.description: Source: Balance Agent, docs/design/cohesion.md §1-2 (2026-10-09), widened by the Village Agent. Change the toast "Fast Travel Destination Unlocked: Town" to "Fast travel unlocked: the village", and the other player-facing "Town" strings to "village": HomesteadTravel.cpp:86, HomesteadControllerTravel.cpp:37, TravelPlaces lines 24/42 (tests HomesteadTravelRestTests.cpp:105, HomesteadFeedbackTest.cpp:121).

entries.title: Water reflections shimmer around the fishing pole and line
entries.description: Jenny (2026-10-09, fishing review): when the heroine moves the fishing pole, the water's reflections of the trees and far bank around the pole and line appear to shift (subtle). Cause (Fishing Agent PIE A/B): Lumen reflection screen traces (r.ReflectionMethod=1) hit the thin pole/line in front of the reflected scenery, so those reflection pixels fall back to a different source and slide as the pole moves; toggling r.Lumen.Reflections.ScreenTraces 0 changes it but alters every reflection. Pre-existing since fishing shipped; game-wide reflection settings, so a rendering/environment-lane fix (e.g. screen-trace thickness tuning), not fishing. Evidence: E:\CopilotScratch\c630ec78-24ce-43d9-929f-0b354f08a801\refl-A-base.mp4 / refl-B-noscreentraces.mp4.

entries.title: Iron upgrade row says "pack full" instead of "craft first"
entries.description: Found in the round-4 Opus 5 review of the Gameplay lane (2026-10-09): for a tool she hasn't crafted yet, the General Store iron upgrade row can show the pack-full refusal instead of "Craft an axe first." Also tidy the ambiguous IsUpgradeRow() check.
